label: Quick start · 2PV7
description: The README's first prediction, fold_input.json: 2PV7, one 298-residue protein entity as a homodimer (chains A and B), with one seed.

label: Ubiquitin monomer
description: The smallest official example: human ubiquitin, one 76-residue protein chain.

label: Barnase–barstar complex
description: A heterodimer of barnase (110 aa) and its inhibitor barstar (89 aa). With the ColabFold MSA option the two chains get a paired alignment, placed first in each chain's MSA.

label: TetR homodimer
description: The tetracycline repressor (218 aa) as a homodimer: one protein entity with two chain IDs.

label: TetR dimer + tetracycline
description: The TetR homodimer with two copies of tetracycline, given by CCD code (TAC).

label: TetR dimer on tetO DNA
description: The TetR homodimer bound to its 20 bp tetO2 operator, as two complementary DNA strands.

label: Calmodulin + 4 Ca²⁺
description: Human calmodulin with four calcium ions, one per EF hand. AlphaFold 3 treats ions as ligands (CCD code CA), here one entity with four IDs.

label: Streptavidin + biotin (SMILES)
description: Core streptavidin with D-biotin given as a SMILES string rather than a CCD code.

label: KRAS G12C + sotorasib (covalent)
description: KRAS4B G12C with sotorasib (CCD MOV), covalently bonded to Cys12 through bondedAtomPairs.

label: RNase B, N-glycosylated
description: Bovine RNase B with a Man3GlcNAc2 glycan at Asn34: a five-component CCD ligand whose linkages and attachment are given as bondedAtomPairs.

label: ERK2, dual-phosphorylated
description: Human ERK2 (360 aa) with activation-loop phosphothreonine (TPO) and phosphotyrosine (PTR) as protein modifications.

label: U1A + RNA hairpin
description: The U1A RRM1 domain with the U1 snRNA stem-loop II hairpin. The RNA runs MSA-free unless the local data pipeline is used.

label: Modified RNA hairpin
description: A 25-nt tRNA-like fragment with pseudouridine, 5-methylcytidine, and 2'-O-methylguanosine modifications. RNA only, so no MSA server is contacted.

label: Methylated CpG dsDNA
description: A 20 bp DNA duplex with 5-methylcytosine at each CpG, on both strands. DNA only, so no MSA server is contacted.
